name: Magic Missile

targets.description: each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see; darts can share a target

summary: Three force darts that never miss, each dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage to a creature you can see.
text: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range and deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage. All the darts strike at the same time, and you can aim them at one creature or spread them among several. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: one more dart for each slot level above 1.
